title: Glass Armor Stand
description: This mod turns armor stand into glass
body:
This resource pack is change armor stand from oak to glass. It change model texture and item texture. It doesn't need an optifine or Entity Model Features. 

In game it looks like this:



![How it looks with Resource Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd43a939332b16c400c5359cf4ef4a64f8954ac3.png)
